chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from 'Asim al-Khayyat, from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), who said:

One who recites Surah al-Muhtarama in his obligatory and recommended prayers, Allah examines his heart for faith, brightens his sight, and poverty will never afflict him, nor insanity in his body or in his children.

key_terms.سُورَةَ الْمُحْتَرِمَةِ: Surah al-Muhtarama (The Dignified), another name for Surah al-Mumtahina

ai.seo_question: What are the virtues and rewards of reciting Surah al-Mumtahina in prayer?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of al-Saduq from Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin), this hadith emphasizes the transformative power of reciting Surah al-Mumtahanah, linking the Surah’s theme of divine testing with personal spiritual refinement. It promises that consistent recitation during obligatory and voluntary prayers results in the purification of the heart for faith, illumination of perception, and enduring protection from poverty and madness for oneself and one's descendants.
